ConfigMakerZapret2SkipProfileDescription: Marks the current profile as disabled so Zapret2 ignores it during traffic processing.

ConfigMakerZapret2TemplateDescription: Saves the current profile as a template that other profiles can import.
ConfigMakerZapret2ImportDescription: Imports a named template: scalar settings are replaced, list settings are appended, and the template number and name are not copied.

ConfigMakerZapret2TransportFilterDescrip: Limits the profile to selected TCP or UDP ports and ranges. A leading ~ means exclusion.
ConfigMakerZapret2IcmpFilterDescription: Limits the profile to ICMP types and codes; * allows any type.
ConfigMakerZapret2IpProtocolFilterDescri: Limits the profile to raw IP protocol numbers. TCP, UDP, and ICMP use their own separate filter groups.
ConfigMakerZapret2FilterL7Description: Applies the profile only to flows recognized as the listed application protocols, such as http, tls, or quic.
ConfigMakerZapret2IpSetDescription: Inclusion filter: the profile applies only to IP addresses and subnets from the file or inline list.
ConfigMakerZapret2IpSetExcludeDescriptio: Exclusion filter: addresses and subnets from the file or inline list are not processed by this profile.
ConfigMakerZapret2HostListDescription: Domain inclusion filter: the profile applies only to names from the TXT file or inline list.
ConfigMakerZapret2HostListExcludeDescrip: Domain exclusion filter: listed names are not processed by this profile.
ConfigMakerZapret2HostListAutoDescriptio: An automatically populated domain inclusion list. A host is added after a detected sequence of connection failures.
ConfigMakerZapret2HostListAutoSettingDes: Configures failure detection and the conditions for adding a domain to the automatic host list.
ConfigMakerZapret2PayloadDescription: Passes only selected payload types to following Lua instances. It remains active until the next --payload; the default is all.
ConfigMakerZapret2OutRangeDescription: Limits following Lua instances by outgoing conntrack counters: n — packet, d — data packet, s — relative sequence, p — data position; a — always, x — never.
ConfigMakerZapret2InRangeDescription: Limits following Lua instances by incoming conntrack counters: n — packet, d — data packet, s — relative sequence, p — data position; a — always, x — never.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaDesyncDescription: Adds a Lua function call with arguments. Calls run strictly in order and use the active payload/in-range/out-range set before them.
ConfigMakerZapret2WinDivertInterfaceDesc: Restricts WinDivert to a specific network interface and optional subinterface.
ConfigMakerZapret2WinDivertL3Description: Restricts the common WinDivert interception filter to IPv4 or IPv6 traffic.
ConfigMakerZapret2WinDivertIncomingDescr: Adds the ports, ICMP types, or IP protocol numbers named by this flag to the incoming WinDivert filter.
ConfigMakerZapret2WinDivertOutgoingDescr: Adds the ports, ICMP types, or IP protocol numbers named by this flag to the outgoing WinDivert filter.
ConfigMakerZapret2WinDivertTcpEmptyDescr: Intercepts empty TCP ACK packets on selected ports. This is needed for an accurate n counter but increases processing overhead.
ConfigMakerZapret2WinDivertRawPartDescri: Adds a partial raw WinDivert filter combined with other parts using OR. The flag may be repeated.
ConfigMakerZapret2WinDivertRawFilterDesc: Adds one partial raw filter combined with the constructed filter using AND.
ConfigMakerZapret2WinDivertFilterLanDesc: Controls whether non-global LAN addresses are excluded from interception; they are excluded by default.
ConfigMakerZapret2WinDivertRawDescriptio: Sets a complete raw WinDivert filter and replaces the filter constructed from all other --wf flags.
ConfigMakerZapret2WinDivertDuplicateDesc: Controls protection against running another winws2 instance with the same WinDivert filter; enabled by default.
ConfigMakerZapret2WinDivertSaveDescripti: Saves the final complete WinDivert filter to a file for inspection and debugging.
ConfigMakerZapret2SsidFilterDescription: Enables interception only while connected to one of the listed Wi-Fi networks.
ConfigMakerZapret2NlmFilterDescription: Enables interception only while connected to one of the listed Windows Network List Manager networks.
ConfigMakerZapret2NlmListDescription: Lists connected Windows Network List Manager networks; all also includes other known networks.
ConfigMakerZapret2NoFlagDescription: No description for this flag was found in the loaded Zapret2 help.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaFakeDescription: fake sends a separate decoy packet or packet group and does not suppress the original; fooling is normally needed so the server rejects the decoy.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaMultisplitDescripti: multisplit cuts the current dissect or reassembly at pos markers and sends real segments in their normal order. After a successful send it drops the original unless nodrop is set.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaMultidisorderDescri: multidisorder cuts data like multisplit but sends the segments in reverse order, from last to first. The original is preserved only with nodrop.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaHostFakeSplitDescri: hostfakesplit cuts HTTP/TLS around the host name and mixes real parts with decoys; fooling must prevent the server from accepting the decoy parts.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaSendDescription: send transmits the current dissect with selected modifications and does not cancel normal delivery. A following drop is needed to suppress the original.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaDropDescription: drop prevents normal delivery of a matching packet by issuing VERDICT_DROP.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaCircularDescription: circular counts failures and rotates through instances marked strategy=N; final prevents cycling back to the beginning.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaMultidisorderLegacy: multidisorder_legacy is the nfqws1-compatible variant: it processes separate replay parts, preserves original segmentation, and reorders segments only within each part.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaFakeSplitDescriptio: fakedsplit cuts data at one position and interleaves real parts with same-sized decoys. The decoys need fooling; nodrop preserves the original.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaFakeDisorderDescrip: fakeddisorder combines reversed real parts with same-sized decoys. The decoys need fooling; nodrop preserves the original.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaTcpSegmentDescripti: tcpseg separately sends part of a dissect, reassembly, or blob between two pos markers. It issues no verdict; combine it with drop to replace the original data.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaOobDescription: oob shifts the TCP sequence and inserts one urgent OOB byte into the first payload, expecting the OS to discard it while the DPI counts it. This is a zero-phase technique with important compatibility limits.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaPacketModifyDescrip: pktmod applies selected modifications to the current dissect but does not send anything or issue a verdict by itself.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaWindowSizeDescripti: wssize temporarily reduces the TCP window and/or scaling factor so the server splits replies. It reduces throughput and is recommended only when alternatives fail.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaSynDataDescription: syndata adds a blob payload to TCP SYN, sends the modified SYN instead of the original, and repeats the action for SYN retransmissions.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaSynAckDescription: synack sends SYN,ACK before the outgoing SYN to confuse DPI about connection direction. It is incompatible with NAT and does not suppress the original.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaResetDescription: rst sends an empty TCP RST or RST,ACK packet and does not suppress normal delivery of the original.
ConfigMakerZapret2LuaUdpLengthDescriptio: udplen changes UDP payload length: shrinking truncates data, while growing appends pattern data. Exceeding MTU may cause IP fragmentation or a send failure.

- your IP address will be disclosed to the proxy provider.

If [Use Proxy] is disabled, the app does not connect to the proxy provider's servers.

By enabling this setting, you acknowledge that you have read this information.
